name: The Bar (Formerly Little Polonia)
description: The Bar is a welcoming neighborhood karaoke bar known for its laid-back vibe and friendly atmosphere. It offers karaoke nights on Tuesdays, featuring a great selection of songs and a cozy setting where guests can enjoy drinks, good company, and singing. The venue is family-friendly, with a relaxed environment that encourages fun and community. Its outdoor area and variety of entertainment options make it a popular spot for both casual singers and groups celebrating special occasions.
